school.school_name: 埼玉コンピュータ＆医療事務専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify that the official-index disclosure page exposes a readable target-form PDF, but the URL, anchor, and PDF body do not prove FY2026.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the disclosure page and inspect the anchor labeled 確認申請書 (様式第2号).
Follow the linked 補正➅確認申請書（様式第2号）.pdf candidate.
Extract the PDF text and confirm it is a 様式第2号 target-form bundle for 埼玉コンピュータ＆医療事務専門学校.
Classify it as needs_operator_review because the PDF text contains no 令和8/2026年度 evidence; incidental 令和7 committee terms do not prove the target fiscal year.

reusable_rules: Keep official-index confirmation-form anchors as high-value candidates even when strict target-year evidence is missing.
Require PDF body, URL, or anchor fiscal-year evidence before accepting a target-form PDF as current target FY.
Route readable target-form PDFs with no FY2026 evidence to needs_operator_review with the direct PDF URL preserved.
anti_patterns: Do not infer FY2026 from an upload month such as /uploads/2025/07/.
Do not treat unrelated 令和7 committee appointment terms inside the PDF as target fiscal-year evidence.
Do not discard a readable target-form PDF as non-target only because it lacks strict year evidence.

evidence.notes: Windows v333 Saitama 50-site replay records this candidate as reason=target_fiscal_year_not_detected, pdf_type=target. Manual PyMuPDF extraction found 16 pages and readable target-form text but no 令和8, 令和８, 2026, or 2026年度 evidence.
